tasks.title: P6.2 Permalink SHA-pinning module (ngv2/permalink_pin.py) — verbatim validated implementation
acceptance_criteria: New file ngv2/permalink_pin.py is created with the exact VALIDATED implementation from the brief (shipped verbatim).
extract_repo(url) parses 'owner/repo' from a GitHub blob URL and returns None for non-matching/empty input.
pin_permalink(url, sha) rewrites /blob/main/ and /blob/master/ to /blob/{sha}/, and returns the URL unchanged when sha is falsy or the URL does not match.

pin_and_verify(urls, sha_resolver, fetcher) resolves each URL's repo to a SHA via the injected sha_resolver, pins it, verifies via the injected fetcher, and returns {"pinned": [...], "dropped": [...]} — HTTP 200 -> pinned, otherwise -> dropped (original URL).
fetcher exceptions are caught and treated as status 0 (the citation is dropped).
Module is stdlib-only (re, typing) with no subprocess, network, gh/curl, LLM, wall-clock, or randomness; all I/O flows through the injected fetcher and sha_resolver seams.
Module exposes Fetcher and ShaResolver type aliases and declares __all__ = ['pin_permalink', 'pin_and_verify', 'extract_repo', 'Fetcher', 'ShaResolver'].
The already-committed RED oracle tests/ngv2/test_permalink_pin_wired.py is NOT modified.

spec.objective: Create the pure, stdlib-only, hermetic module ngv2/permalink_pin.py that ports the legacy prepare_submissions.sh permalink logic: rewrite GitHub blob permalinks from a moving branch ref (/blob/main/ or /blob/master/) to an immutable commit SHA (/blob/{sha}/), verify each pinned permalink resolves (HTTP 200) via an INJECTED fetcher seam, and DROP any citation whose pinned URL no longer resolves. SHA resolution is also an INJECTED sha_resolver seam (owner/repo -> commit SHA). Ship the VALIDATED implementation from the brief verbatim as the whole file.
functional_requirements: extract_repo(url: str) -> Optional[str] returns 'owner/repo' parsed from a GitHub blob URL via _REPO_RE, or None when there is no match or the input is empty/None.

pin_permalink(url: str, sha: str) -> str rewrites /blob/main/ or /blob/master/ to /blob/{sha}/ using _BRANCH_BLOB_RE, preserving the host+owner+repo prefix; URLs already pinned to a SHA or that do not match are returned unchanged.
pin_permalink returns the URL unchanged when sha is falsy (empty string / None).

pin_and_verify(urls, sha_resolver, fetcher) -> dict pins each URL to its repo's SHA (via sha_resolver) and verifies the pinned URL with fetcher, returning {'pinned': [...], 'dropped': [...]} where HTTP 200 results go to pinned (the SHA-pinned URL) and all other statuses go to dropped (the original URL).
pin_and_verify treats any exception raised by fetcher as status 0 (dropped), and handles a None/empty urls list by iterating over nothing.

The module performs NO real network/subprocess/gh/curl/LLM/wall-clock/randomness; it depends only on the standard library (re, typing) and routes all external access through the injected fetcher and sha_resolver callables.
The module defines Fetcher and ShaResolver Callable type aliases and an __all__ exporting pin_permalink, pin_and_verify, extract_repo, Fetcher, ShaResolver.
spec.interfaces: exposes `pin_permalink(url, sha) -> str` (rewrite /blob/main|master/ -> /blob/{sha}/), `extract_repo(url) -> str|None` (parse owner/repo from a GitHub blob URL), and `pin_and_verify(urls, sha_resolver, fetcher) -> dict` returning {"pinned": [...], "dropped": [...]}. Injected seams: sha_resolver(owner_repo: str) -> Optional[str]; fetcher(url: str) -> int (HTTP status code). Type aliases Fetcher = Callable[[str], int], ShaResolver = Callable[[str], Optional[str]].
edge_cases: URL already pinned to a 40-char SHA (no /blob/main|master/) -> pin_permalink returns it unchanged.
URL whose repo has no SHA (sha_resolver returns None) -> URL is left unpinned and then verified as-is.
URL that is not a GitHub blob URL -> extract_repo returns None, sha is None, URL passes through unpinned to the fetcher.
fetcher returns a non-200 status (e.g. 404 because the cited code moved/was removed) -> original URL is dropped.
fetcher raises an exception -> treated as status 0 -> dropped.
Empty or None urls input -> returns {'pinned': [], 'dropped': []}.
Empty/None url passed to extract_repo -> returns None (guarded by `url or ''`).
non_goals: No real network, gh, or curl calls — fetch and sha-resolution are injected callables only.
No subprocess, LLM, wall-clock, or randomness.
Do NOT render the submission document (P6.1).
Do NOT modify the committed RED oracle tests/ngv2/test_permalink_pin_wired.py.

# COMMITTED ORACLE CONTRACT (authoritative; you cannot read these files at synthesis time so they are reproduced verbatim -- your code MUST make them pass):

## tests/ngv2/test_permalink_pin_wired.py
```python
"""Wired RED oracle for ngv2/permalink_pin.py (P6.2).

Hermetic: injects a canned fetcher + sha-resolver. Asserts SHA-pinning of
/blob/main|master/ -> /blob/{sha}/, 200-verification, and drop-on-404.
"""
from ngv2.permalink_pin import pin_permalink, pin_and_verify, extract_repo

SHA = 'a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2'


def _resolver(repo):
    return {'iterative/dvc': SHA, 'org/repo': SHA}.get(repo)


def test_extract_repo():
    assert extract_repo(
        'https://github.com/iterative/dvc/blob/main/tree.py#L171') == 'iterative/dvc'


def test_pin_rewrites_main_branch_to_sha():
    url = 'https://github.com/iterative/dvc/blob/main/dvc/tree.py#L171'
    out = pin_permalink(url, SHA)
    assert f'/blob/{SHA}/' in out
    assert '/blob/main/' not in out
    assert out.endswith('#L171')


def test_pin_rewrites_master_branch_to_sha():
    url = 'https://github.com/org/repo/blob/master/a.py#L1'
    out = pin_permalink(url, SHA)
    assert f'/blob/{SHA}/' in out
    assert '/blob/master/' not in out


def test_already_pinned_unchanged():
    url = f'https://github.com/org/repo/blob/{SHA}/a.py#L1'
    assert pin_permalink(url, SHA) == url


def test_pin_and_verify_keeps_resolving_links():
    urls = [
        'https://github.com/iterative/dvc/blob/main/tree.py#L171',
        'https://github.com/org/repo/blob/master/a.py#L1',
    ]
    result = pin_and_verify(urls, _resolver, fetcher=lambda u: 200)
    assert len(result['pinned']) == 2
    assert result['dropped'] == []
    for u in result['pinned']:
        assert f'/blob/{SHA}/' in u


def test_pin_and_verify_drops_on_404():
    urls = [
        'https://github.com/iterative/dvc/blob/main/good.py#L1',
        'https://github.com/iterative/dvc/blob/main/moved.py#L9',
    ]

    def fetcher(u):
        return 404 if 'moved.py' in u else 200

    result = pin_and_verify(urls, _resolver, fetcher=fetcher)
    assert len(result['pinned']) == 1
    assert 'good.py' in result['pinned'][0]
    assert len(result['dropped']) == 1
    assert 'moved.py' in result['dropped'][0]


def test_fetcher_exception_drops_citation():
    def boom(u):
        raise RuntimeError('network down')

    urls = ['https://github.com/org/repo/blob/main/a.py#L1']
    result = pin_and_verify(urls, _resolver, fetcher=boom)
    assert result['pinned'] == []
    assert len(result['dropped']) == 1

```

test_spec.test_data_requirements: Deterministic in-memory stub seams: a sha_resolver dict mapping 'owner/repo' -> fixed 40-char SHA (and a repo with no entry -> None), and a fetcher dict/closure mapping pinned URLs -> status codes (200 for resolvable, 404 for moved/removed) plus a variant that raises to exercise the exception path. Sample GitHub blob URLs for /blob/main/, /blob/master/, an already-SHA-pinned URL, and a non-GitHub URL. No network, files, or randomness.
